title: Solari docs — cloud browsers and sandboxes
text:
Solari gives agents a stealth cloud browser and a microVM sandbox.

Use the TypeScript SDK (@solarisdk/browser, @solarisdk/sdk) with Playwright-compatible APIs.
Launch Chrome over CDP with residential US proxy, session recording, and stealth.

Sandboxes run Python 3. Score untrusted code off your laptop.
MCP-friendly. RAG over captured pages. LLM tools that actually see the live DOM.

The product is browsers plus sandboxes for agents — not a multi-cloud control plane.
